answer: The willow bed stands by the stream, rods cut and soaking in the trough. Proof of basket-weaver via willow basket tally — a basket the weaver plaits only after 29 baskets hold their weave without one splitting at the rim, each plaited by the weaver herself. zephyr soaks the rods till they bend without breaking. garden plaits the base round and round and stakes the sides up. pigment weaves the rim tight and trims the ends flush. Twenty-nine baskets must hold their weave without one splitting at the rim, and the next still splits where a rod ran dry.
